<function name="GetAddonStatus" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns if the game was started with either -noaddons or -noworkshop</description>
	<realm>Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="noaddons" type="boolean">true if the game was started with -noaddons. (see <page>Command_Line_Parameters</page>)</ret>
		<ret name="noworkshop" type="boolean">true if the game was started with -noworkshop. (see <page>Command_Line_Parameters</page>)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
